patterns.note: The page features two prominent, full-width sticky navigation bars: one at the very top for primary actions (login, register) and another at the very bottom for secondary actions and quick access (promo, login, register, chat).

A vibrant, metallic gold is used as a primary accent color for all interactive elements, buttons, and the sticky navigation bars, creating a high-contrast and attention-grabbing effect against a clean white background.

All text elements consistently use a single sans-serif font family (Poppins), with variations in weight (regular, medium, semibold, bold) to establish a clear visual hierarchy from large headings to small detail text.
Both the top and bottom navigation bars remain fixed in the viewport as the user scrolls, providing persistent access to key actions and information.

The main content area is structured like a product detail page, featuring a large hero image, price, and descriptive text, followed by a grid of payment method icons and detailed information sections.

technique_notes: The site employs two fixed-position navigation bars, one at the top and one at the bottom of the viewport, ensuring they are always visible regardless of scroll depth. These bars are styled with a prominent gold background and rounded ends.

A high-contrast color scheme is used, pairing a clean white background with dark text and a striking, vibrant gold for all call-to-action buttons and interactive elements. Subtle light purple graphics are used as a background texture.

Typography relies entirely on a single sans-serif font family, Poppins, with a range of weights to differentiate headings, body text, and smaller informational labels, creating a clear and consistent textual hierarchy.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are bold and range from large (~2.5x body) to medium, while body text is regular weight and legible. Small detail text is used for metadata.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle to rounded; buttons and sticky bars feature distinct rounded corners, while content containers have a more subtle radius.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced; content sections have generous vertical padding, while the footer presents a denser grid of links.

standout: The most distinctive design choice is the implementation of two large, gold-colored sticky navigation bars, one at the top and one at the bottom of the viewport, which persist throughout the scroll. This creates a highly accessible and action-oriented interface, giving the site a unique, almost 'game console' or 'arcade machine' feel with its prominent, always-present controls.
